newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in moderate trade on some late selling interest in line with weaker Japanese prices, dealers said on Thursday.
They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe also ended lower pressured by profit-taking sales after most futures contracts broke above Wednesday's strong resistance at 160 yen.
"Most people were marking time in the morning. But some speculative selling emerged in the afternoon in sympathy with softer prices in Tokyo and Kobe. Volume was moderate," a local broker said.
At 0945 GMT, April RSS3 fell 1.25 cents to 123.50 U.S. cents a kg.
July/September RSS1 fell 1.25 cents to 178.50 Singapore cents (US$1.26) a kg.
July/September TSR20 fell half a cent to 171.75 Singapore cents (US$1.22) a kg.
